body:
Triage: routed `domain:skills`, type Task, stays `finding` for the skills seat (#7623) to grade. Rationale: the proposed landing point is AGENTS.md's reverse-verification section — repo governance text in the same human-merge class as skills — and the pipeline for "workflow doctrine gap found by a dev" runs through the skills seat, next to the stash prohibition this is explicitly sibling to.

Grading note: the finding is mechanism-verified by its own reporter (index vs working-tree divergence, caught via `MM` in `git status --porcelain` on PR #8277 with 157 deletions staged), so the premise needs no re-measurement — the only open question is shape (docs note vs an index-divergence guard at commit/PR time). The guard idea belongs to the gate farm and would be its own card; do not let this card grow it.

Graded by the skills seat (session `session_018WuTtyckQa1VcXwgd52JpN`, under this shift's maintainer grading grant): **PROMOTED to `pm:queue`.** Deliverable = the card's own suggested shape: a short note in AGENTS.md's reverse-verification section, beside the stash warning (same family — a git operation whose blast radius is wider than it reads): `git checkout <ref> -- <path>` **stages**; restore with `git checkout HEAD -- <path>` or `git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree <path>`; verify `git status --porcelain` (watch for `MM`) before committing; ⛔ never trust `git diff HEAD` alone after a checkout-from-ref. The stronger index-vs-worktree commit guard stays out of scope — a named possibility for the gate-farm owner, not this card.

Reasonableness check (three axes): the prescribed reverse-verification workflow walks straight into the trap on essentially every card (real pull); a one-note fix beside the existing stash warning is the minimal durable form (long-term coherence, no new mechanism); and the failure mode it prevents — a PR that silently reverts its own fix while everything reads green — is precisely the AI-error class that review cannot reliably catch after the fact.

AGENTS.md is governance text → conservative ADR-class treatment: draft PR, human merge, listed as awaiting a human merge. Size S, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (judgment-light text edit; not under the fable-mandatory roots).

**Seat ruling on the report's open question** (skills seat, session `session_018WuTtyckQa1VcXwgd52JpN`, under this shift's grading grant): **take option B's content, but land it in THIS PR** — one clause appended to the same note naming the measured non-staging way in: `git restore --source=<ref> -- <path>` (without `--staged`) writes the working tree only (porcelain shows ` M`, not `MM`), so the trap never arises.

Three-axis rationale: prevention-at-source beats cure-only — an agent that never stages the foreign copy cannot commit it (AI-error-resistance); the clause is measured this run, not speculative; and one clause in the note being merged is the minimal durable form — a separate card for one sentence is process overhead with no added safety. The dev's restraint was correct under the ADR-class rule (⛔ no unilateral widening of governance text); the widening is now covered by this recorded seat ruling, and the maintainer still reviews the final text at hand-merge.

Patch round: seat ruling implemented. **New head sha `f1c0aeecea18d57d4017e4b5a27357a5e602a9f2`** (fast-forward on `claude/issue-8280-agents-checkout-staging-trap`, no force-push). PR #8472 remains a **draft** — not flipped ready, no auto-merge armed.

**Amendment** — one clause appended to the same note, in its existing idiom (+4/-1 lines; the note is now 17 lines total):

> Better still, don't stage it at all: `git restore --source=<ref> -- <path>` (no `--staged`) writes the tree only — porcelain shows a lone unstaged `M`, not `MM` — so prefer it when standing another ref's version up for a counterfactual.

**Re-measured before writing**, with the exact `--`-separated form the clause prescribes, against the real scenario on this branch (HEAD holds the note, `origin/main` does not — my earlier evidence used the same command without the `--` separator, so I re-ran it rather than reuse it):

```
$ git restore --source=origin/main -- AGENTS.md
$ git status --porcelain AGENTS.md
 M AGENTS.md                                  # lone unstaged M, not MM
$ git show :AGENTS.md | sed -n '195p'
**⛔ And `git checkout <ref> -- <path>` STAGES what it retr…   # index still holds the note
$ git diff --cached --stat -- AGENTS.md
(empty — index untouched)
$ git checkout HEAD -- AGENTS.md
$ git hash-object AGENTS.md   -> cd93beb04eb8acfeb9aa2a5b5546a6bd5211eee8
$ git rev-parse HEAD:AGENTS.md -> cd93beb04eb8acfeb9aa2a5b5546a6bd5211eee8   # byte-identical
```

**Gates, both re-run in the foreground on the amended tree, both green:**

- `pnpm check:nul-bytes` — `✓ self-test: 75 assertions` + `OK (scanned 7637 text file(s) … no raw ASCII control bytes)`, exit 0
- `pnpm check:doc-authoring` — self-test all holds + `✓ doc authoring guard: 376 files clean`, exit 0
- control-byte self-scan of AGENTS.md (`grep -naP` over the control ranges): no hits

PR body updated: Scope line +14 → **+17 lines across two commits**, plus a section recording the ruled amendment and its measurement. Nothing else touched — the diff is still AGENTS.md only. Labels unchanged (`documentation`, `size/s`, `skip-changeset`).

- **Scope**: matches the claim exactly; the note lands precisely where the trap lives — immediately after the reverse-verification paragraph whose own prescription (`git checkout your-branch -- <path>`) is the staging form.
- **Measured, twice over**: the trap chain was reproduced by probe commit before writing (MM → clean `git diff HEAD` → index-built commit deleting the fix), and the amendment's non-staging way in was re-measured in the exact prescribed form (`--` separator, real scenario on this branch: lone ` M`, index untouched, byte-identity of the restore proven by `git hash-object` == `rev-parse HEAD:`). The note also **corrects the card's own mechanism claim** (`git diff HEAD` compares tree↔HEAD, never the index) — governance text now states what was measured, not what was quoted.
- **Discipline**: the ADR-class widening happened only under the recorded seat ruling; fast-forward push; draft preserved through every write; labels intact; gates 2/2 green foreground; the PR even applied its own documented pre-commit index check to itself.
- **综合分析 (three axes)**: repo-wide recurring exposure (the prescribed workflow walks into it); minimal durable form beside the stash warning (no new mechanism); and the amendment upgrades cure-only to prevention-at-source — the AI-error class this exists for is a merged PR that silently reverts its own fix.

**Terminal state: ADR-class.** PR #8472 stays a visibly-open **draft** for the maintainer's hand-merge. This card closes via the PR's `Fixes` line at merge.
